Series B (30 Jul 2021, RMB100m): led by Gaoxintou (HTI Group) incl. Chengdu Zhongxiaodan, Shenrong Ruihe, Rencai No. 2, Xiaohe, Taolue Xinwang, Kaiying No. 10, Zhu Zhenkui, Fuquan No. 1
Series C (18 Oct 2024): Jinlan Sunshine (Zheshang Capital), Panhui Investment, Kezhihua
Zheshang Capital Group (Taolue New Energy, Taolue Xinwang, Jinlan Sunshine; GP Zhejiang Business Venture Capital Management (Shenzhen)) holds 14.86%
board_roster_reviewed: Nine directors at LPD. Executive: Zhou Bo (chair/GM, founder), Miao Rui, Chai Jian (board secretary; ex fund/securities asset-management roles, not linked to investors), Zou Xiaogang, Chen Yonggang. Non-executive: Yu Lijie - appointed Director 30 Dec 2020 (one month after the Zheshang-led Series A), re-designated NED July 2025; general manager (deputy GM from Mar 2013, GM from Aug 2017) of Zhejiang Business Venture Capital Management (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd., the GP/manager of the three Zheshang pre-IPO investment funds; sits on Audit Committee. INEDs: Chen Haiping (university finance), Zhong Luhuan (partner at Zhonghong Jin Kong; ex-Hony PE fund manager to Jan 2025; not linked to a pre-IPO investor), Ho Ka Cin Verona (lawyer). Only Yu Lijie is linked to a pre-IPO investor institution.
rights_and_timing: Special rights of pre-IPO investors (co-sale, redemption, information, anti-dilution, pre-emptive, liquidation preference) do NOT include a board nomination/observer right in the listed rights, and all special rights were terminated on filing of the listing application (some reinstate only if listing fails). So there is no disclosed contractual appointment right; the link is that a seated non-executive director is a senior executive (GM) of the GP/manager of Zheshang pre-IPO investor funds, who remain a 14.86% shareholder at listing. The prospectus does not state that he was nominated by the investors, and the bio gives no end date for his Zheshang role. The bio is worded as a past-tense narrative under prior experience, so continuing employment at listing is inferred from the absence of an end date.
